items.label: Anti fall damage
items.desc: Suppress ordinary fall damage for the local survivor in supported local sessions.

items.label: Ping reducer
items.desc: Reduce client interpolation delay. This changes interpolation settings; it does not reduce network latency.

items.label: Anti AFK
items.desc: Prevent the local inactivity timeout while enabled.

items.label: No push
items.desc: Disable teammate avoidance and physics-object push effects while enabled.

items.label: SvPure bypass
items.desc: Temporarily relax the client pure-file checks in a local session. Previous settings return when disabled.

items.label: Airstuck

items.label: Unified atmosphere library

items.label: Apply atmosphere preset
items.desc: Apply coordinated sky, world and static-prop colors, then fine-tune them independently.

items.label: Restore original world
items.desc: Disable environment overrides and restore the saved original colors and sky textures.

items.label: Skybox library
items.desc: Choose among twelve sky presets. Recognized sky faces and supported LDR/HDR/RGBS formats can be replaced; unsupported custom skies retain their original texture.

items.label: Sky brightness
items.desc: Adjust the brightness of successfully replaced sky materials.

items.label: Map and material refresh
items.desc: Discover late-loaded world and sky materials, rebind when the preset changes and restore original textures on disable or map transition. This does not establish support for every custom-map shader.

items.label: World tint
items.desc: Tint map surface materials; restores their original colors when disabled.

items.label: Sky tint
items.desc: Tint skybox materials; restores their original colors when disabled.

items.label: Static prop tint
items.desc: Tint static prop materials independently of map surfaces and sky.

items.label: Night preset
items.desc: Apply coordinated colors to the world, props and sky.

items.label: Warm preset
items.desc: Apply coordinated colors to the world, props and sky.

items.label: Cool preset
items.desc: Apply coordinated colors to the world, props and sky.

items.label: Restore world
items.desc: Disable world, prop and sky tint and restore the game materials.

items.label: World pulse
items.desc: Animate world and static-prop brightness.

items.label: Animated sky color
items.desc: Blend sky tint toward a secondary color over time.

items.label: 27 built-in materials
items.desc: Browse texture previews and apply a preset to the selected target and layer.
settings: New styles: Dark matter, Acid, Vortex, Hologram, Frost, Inferno, Circuit, Pearl
Existing styles include lit, flat, wireframe, glow, galaxy, lightning, plasma, aurora and molten

items.label: Independent material layers
items.desc: Select Visible, Invisible or Overlay for each supported actor, self, arms or weapon target. Keep separate material, color, opacity and animation choices.

items.label: Eight layer animation modes
items.desc: Animate layer color or opacity with an independent speed, strength and secondary color.

items.label: Scrolling material textures
items.desc: Built-in animated presets use scrolling UV textures; compatible imported VMTs can use the TextureScroll proxy.

items.label: Animated previews
items.desc: Preview texture motion and layer tint in the selected-material swatch. Enable Animate preview to play matching custom GIFs.

items.label: Custom material library
items.desc: Use Open folder, add same-name VMT/VTF pairs and press Refresh. Supported shaders are VertexLitGeneric and UnlitGeneric; start from Add example.
settings: Single-frame 2D VTF 7.2–7.5, power-of-two textures up to 1024 × 1024
RGBA/ABGR/ARGB/BGRA8888, RGB/BGR888, DXT1, DXT3 and DXT5
Supported switches, alpha and TextureScroll; arbitrary shaders/proxies are not imported

items.label: Automatic PNG and GIF previews
items.desc: Place name.png or name.gif beside name.vmt and name.vtf. The matching basename selects the preview automatically.
settings: PNG takes priority when both exist
GIF previews animate; the game uses the VTF texture
